name: real-alpha
description: Ask what the people building AI said in long interviews, and get their words, the show, the date and a page to cite.

interface.longDescription:
Real Alpha finds what the people building AI actually said in long interviews and podcasts. It covers founders, CEOs and researchers at AI labs and companies, on shows like Lenny's Podcast, Dwarkesh Podcast, No Priors and BG2, with new moments every hour.

Ask what someone said about a subject and ChatGPT gets the moments that match: the speaker and what they do, the show, the date, their own words, a short summary, and a link to the moment's page on realalpha.app, which plays the episode from that minute. A search can be narrowed to one person, a company, a show or a date.

It can also:
- List what one person has said, newest first, or only on one topic.
- Show where AI leaders stand on big questions like "Is AI a bubble?" or "Will AI replace software engineers?", grouped by which way they answer.
- Read about a minute of an episode's transcript, to check the exact words around a quote.
- Bring up the newest moments from every show, or from one.

It's for anyone who follows AI, such as founders, engineers, investors, reporters and students, who wants a person's own words with a source to cite instead of a paraphrase.

Limits: it only covers the episodes Real Alpha has cut, so it can miss things said elsewhere. It returns short excerpts and links, not whole episodes or transcripts, and machine transcripts can misspell names. It only reads, and needs no account.
capabilities: Search what AI leaders said by subject, person, company, show or date
List what one person said, on any topic or one
Show how AI leaders answer big questions about AI
Read a minute of an episode's transcript
Get the newest moments from every show or one
defaultPrompt: What has Jensen Huang said about demand for AI chips?
Is AI a bubble? What do the people building it say?
What have AI founders said about coding agents this month?

positive.description: Search by subject: what AI builders said about something, with the speaker, show, date, their words and a link for each moment.
positive.prompt: What have AI founders and engineers said about coding agents replacing engineers?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_moments with a query like "coding agents replacing engineers". The answer names several speakers with what they do, the show and date, quotes or paraphrases each one's words, and links each moment's realalpha.app/s/ page. It doesn't present anyone's view as fact.

positive.description: One named person on one topic: who they are, their moments on it, and their page.
positive.prompt: What has Jensen Huang said about demand for AI chips?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls what_did_they_say with person "Jensen Huang" and a topic like "demand". The answer says he is Founder & CEO of NVIDIA, gives his moments on demand newest first (such as "Nvidia demand rests on three segments, not two AI labs" on BG2, Oct 15, 2026) with his quotes and links, and can link his page, realalpha.app/builders/jensen-huang/.

positive.description: A big question: how the people building AI answer it, grouped by which way they answer.
positive.prompt: Is AI a bubble? What do the people building it actually say?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls answers_to with question "is-ai-a-bubble". The answer gives how many moments answer it and the groups by stance, biggest first (such as "Not a bubble" and "Partly a bubble"), with a few speakers in each, what each says, the show and date, and links, plus the question's page, realalpha.app/q/is-ai-a-bubble/.

positive.description: A shared moment's link, then the exact words around its quote from the episode's transcript.
positive.prompt: Open https://realalpha.app/s/nvidia-demand-rests-on-three-segments-not-two-ai-labs/ and show me the transcript around the quote.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_moment with the link, then transcript_excerpt with video eS7qQ3WJSrw at second 3717 from the moment's episode_url. The answer gives the moment (Jensen Huang on BG2, at 1:01:57), about a minute of timed transcript lines from 1:01:49, notes it's a machine transcript, and links the episode at that minute.

positive.prompt: What's new from the Dwarkesh Podcast? Give me the latest moments.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls latest_moments with show "Dwarkesh Podcast". The answer lists the newest moments from that show, newest episode first, each with the speaker, the episode, the date, a one-line summary and its link.

negative.description: A write action. Real Alpha only reads: it can't send, post or save anything, so it should say so and not call a tool to try.
negative.prompt: Email Jensen Huang's latest quote to my team.

negative.description: A request with nothing to do with what AI leaders said in interviews. Real Alpha's tools shouldn't be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in New York tomorrow?

negative.description: A request to delete or change what Real Alpha holds. Its tools only read, so ChatGPT should say it can't and not try; nothing changes.
negative.prompt: Delete the Jensen Huang moments from Real Alpha.

review.commerce_description: Real Alpha sells nothing in ChatGPT and takes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Six read-only tools over Real Alpha's moments from long interviews with the people building AI: search them, see what one person said, see how AI leaders answer big questions, read a minute of an episode's transcript, open one moment, and get the newest.
